description: Use this when the user applies for a job (Bewerbung) or you need anything about them: their name and contact (angaben) and the resume (Lebenslauf) on file (cv: job title, years of experience, skills, positions, education, languages, the day it was saved). Use it silently; never ask for what is here; summarize the resume only if asked. Scope: cv:lesen.
name: get_profile

angaben.description: Name and contact from the resume; null where it names none.

cv.description: The resume fields and gespeichertAm, the day it was saved; null without one.

title: Show your details and resume (Lebenslauf)
